GoodTrust review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: An all-in-one US estate planning platform: will, trust and directives (valid in all 50 states) plus a Digital Vault for your digital life.

Best for: US families who want estate documents and digital-account planning in one place.

Pricing: Estate+ plan advertised at $149 (US). Check current pricing.

Official site / docs ↗

Pros

  • Will, trust, power of attorney, health care, funeral and pet directives
  • Family plan with no extra fee per person
  • Digital Vault where you choose who gets access and when

Cons

  • Estate documents are US-centric
  • Feature set varies by tier

FAQ

What is GoodTrust best for?

US families who want estate documents and digital-account planning in one place.

How much does GoodTrust cost?

Estate+ plan advertised at $149 (US). Check current pricing.
